message.content:
{
  "purpose": "Payment method selection and agreement confirmation for a reservation.",
  "observations": [
    {
      "id": "E1",
      "group": "OS Status Bar",
      "role": "System information",
      "visibleText": ["10:23"],
      "observed": "Top-left corner displays the time '10:23'. Top-right displays Wi-Fi and battery icons."
    },
    {
      "id": "E2",
      "group": "App Header",
      "role": "Navigation and Title",
      "visibleText": ["예약"],
      "observed": "Header contains a left-pointing back arrow icon on the left and the centered title '예약' (Reservation)."
    },
    {
      "id": "E3",
      "group": "Payment Section",
      "role": "Section Header",
      "visibleText": ["결제 수단"],
      "observed": "Bold text '결제 수단' (Payment Method) serves as the header for the grid of options below it."
    },
    {
      "id": "E4",
      "group": "Payment Options Grid",
      "role": "Selection List",
      "visibleText": ["pay", "toss pay", "신용/체크 카드", "콕계좌이체", "N pay", "PAYCO", "법인 카드", "휴대폰 결제", "간편 계좌이체"],
      "observed": "A 3x3 grid of selectable buttons. The top-left button 'pay' is visually highlighted with a light blue background, indicating it is the currently selected payment method."
    },
    {
      "id": "E5",
      "group": "Payment Persistence",
      "role": "Checkbox",
      "visibleText": ["이 결제 수단을 다음에도 사용"],
      "observed": "A checkbox with a blue checkmark is located below the payment grid. The text '이 결제 수단을 다음에도 사용' (Use this payment method next time) is to its right."
    },
    {
      "id": "E6",
      "group": "Agreement Section",
      "role": "Section Header",
      "visibleText": ["전체 동의"],
      "observed": "A checkbox with a blue checkmark is next to the bold text '전체 동의' (Agree to All)."
    },
    {
      "id": "E7",
      "group": "Agreement List",
      "role": "List of Terms",
      "visibleText": ["렌터카 이용 및 취소/환불규정 동의 (필수)", "개인정보 수집 및 이용 동의 (필수)", "개인정보 제3자 제공 동의 (필수)"],
      "observed": "Three rows of mandatory agreements, each with a checked blue checkbox on the left and a chevron icon on the right. Text includes '(필수)' (Required)."
    },
    {
      "id": "E8",
      "group": "Action Button",
      "role": "Primary Action",
      "visibleText": ["10,057원 결제하기"],
      "observed": "A large blue button spanning the width of the content area. It displays the total amount '10,057원' and the action '결제하기' (Pay)."
    },
    {
      "id": "E9",
      "group": "Footer Disclaimer",
      "role": "Legal Text",
      "visibleText": ["(주)여기어때컴퍼니는...", "상품의 예약, 이용 및 환불 등과 관련된 의무와 책임은 각 판매자에게 있습니다."],
      "observed": "Small gray text at the bottom explaining that the company is an intermediary and the seller is responsible for obligations and liabilities."
    }
  ],
  "relations": [
    "E4 (Grid) is visually grouped under E3 (Header).",
    "E5 (Checkbox) is positioned immediately below E4 (Grid).",
    "E6 (Header) is positioned below E5 (Checkbox).",
    "E7 (List) is vertically stacked below E6 (Header).",
    "E8 (Button) is positioned below E7 (List) and above E9 (Footer)."
  ],
  "unknowns": [
    "The specific payment provider logo for the 'pay' button in E4.",
    "The exact font family used for the Korean text.",
    "The precise hex color code for the blue button E8.",
    "The exact pixel padding values for the buttons in E4.",
    "The specific behavior of the chevron icons in E7 (e.g., do they open a modal?)."
  ]
}
